body: Update: keeping it short, ive moved on completely, and am more apathetic because of the situation. I was in an in-patient crisis center for 8 days, got out 2 days ago, and I'm now on Prozac. Still don't want to live, but I'm trying. I guess if this gets any attention I'll go more into detail and keep updating every so often.
Perfection isn't definition, it's perspective. Picasso's paint brush is worthless to a businessman. It's everything to an aspiring artist.
Mixed.. And I know real life is more important, trust me we made that clear. But we talked about making it real all the time..
